about: The source model of a Leica LIF file (spec/zarrify/lif.md §5.4 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/lif.md#54-elements>): the elements a parser emits, and the roles the file, its header block, its XML header, an image, a dimension, a channel, an image's layout, its memory block and the series play, each with the constraints a file must meet to have the LIF convention's layout (spec/zarrify/lif.md §7.3 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/lif.md#73-rejection>). The parser checks them in this order, the images in document order; projections read a valid IR and check nothing.

elements.about: The IR of a LIF file. n is the XML header's length in bytes (twice its characters), i a memory block's index in file order, H its fixed part (18 bytes for version 1, 22 for version 2), m its ID's length in bytes, D its data's size.

header/xml.extent: (13, n), when n > 0: the XML header

blocks/<i>.extent: the block: its fixed part, its ID and its data

blocks/<i>/data.form: {geometry: {image}, codec: {endian: little}, recipe: [[src, 0, null]]} for the block of an image; else a value of type bytes[D]

tail.about: the bytes from where the walk ends to the end of the file

constraints.message: the {size}-byte file is too short for a LIF header block
not a LIF file: the header block's test value is {test} and its magic byte {magic}, not 112 and 42
the XML header of {chars} characters runs past the end of the {size}-byte file
the XML header of {chars} characters is longer than 2^27 bytes

given.version: the root's Version, an integer or its text

constraints.message: the XML header is not well-formed UTF-16
a Leica object file (LOF): the profile reads LIF files only
the XML header's root element is {root}, not LMSDataContainerHeader
unsupported LIF version {version}: the XML header's Version is not 1 or 2

given.name: its Name
given.memory: it has a Memory element with a MemoryBlockID

constraints.message: image {k} ({name}) has no Memory element with a MemoryBlockID
image {k} ({name}) has {dimensions} DimensionDescription elements, not 1 to 16
image {k} ({name}) has {channels} ChannelDescription elements, not 1 to 1024

given.bit_inc: BitInc, absent when the attribute is

constraints.message: image {k} ({name}): dimension {j}'s DimID, NumberOfElements or BytesInc ({dim_id}, {elements}, {bytes_inc}) is not an integer
image {k} ({name}): dimension {j} has NumberOfElements 0
image {k} ({name}): dimension {j} has BitInc {bit_inc}: bit-packed data is not supported

given.bit_inc: BitInc, absent when the attribute is

constraints.message: image {k} ({name}): channel {j}'s DataType, Resolution or BytesInc ({data_type}, {resolution}, {bytes_inc}) is not an integer
image {k} ({name}): channel {j} has an unsupported DataType {data_type}, not 0 (integer) or 1 (float)
image {k} ({name}): channel {j} has an unsupported Resolution of {resolution} bits, not 1 to 64
image {k} ({name}): channel {j} is an unsupported float of {resolution} bits
image {k} ({name}): channel {j} has BitInc {bit_inc}: bit-packed data is not supported

given.x: it has a dimension of DimID 1
given.repeated: a DimID two dimensions of more than one element have
given.distinct: no two channels have one BytesInc
given.arranged: the channels are planar or interleaved
given.rows_overlap: Y has more than one element and a BytesInc below a row's bytes
given.extent: the largest of the array's shape
given.planes: the chunks of one row band: times, channels (1 when interleaved), depths and fields
given.references: 2^22 + 4 x the file's size, the references a run makes at most

constraints.message: image {k} ({name}) has no X dimension (DimID 1)
image {k} ({name}) has two dimensions of DimID {repeated} with more than one element
image {k} ({name}) has channels of different data types
image {k} ({name}) has two channels at one BytesInc ({offsets})
image {k} ({name}): channels at BytesInc {offsets} with an X BytesInc of {x_bytes_inc} are neither planar nor interleaved
image {k} ({name}): rows of {row} bytes, {y_bytes_inc} bytes apart, overlap
image {k} ({name}) has an array extent of {extent}, more than 2^31
image {k} ({name}) has {fields} fields, more than 65536
image {k} ({name}) has {planes} planes, more than the {references} references the file may have

memory.about: the memory block an image names (spec/zarrify/lif.md §2.3 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/lif.md#23-images>)

given.found: the blocks of that ID the walk found
given.other: the earlier image that names the block
given.need: the bytes the image's layout reaches

constraints.message: image {k} ({name}) names memory block {id}, which the file does not hold
image {k} ({name}) names memory block {id}, which the file holds {found} times
image {k} ({name}) names memory block {id}, which image {other} names too
image {k} ({name}) reaches {need_shown} bytes into memory block {id}, which holds {held}
the file has more than 65536 series
